title: DocVault - Document Manager
summary: Store, scan & organize documents securely. Offline. Private. On your phone.
description:
Introducing DocVault, the ultimate solution for easy and secure document management. Seamlessly carry your digital documents wherever you go, Whether it's personal documents or professional files, DocVault ensures easy accessibility while maintaining the highest level of security. With its user-friendly interface and robust features, DocVault sets a new standard in simplicity, reliability, security, and privacy. With just a few clicks, you can easily share documents with your friends, family members, or colleagues.

With DocVault,

• Efficient Organization: Keep your documents structured and accessible, with predefined categories such as ID Proofs, Invoices, Vehicle and prescriptions. Additionally, you have the flexibility to create and manage new categories as per your needs.

• Capture and Import: Easily add or scan documents using your device's camera, gallery, or import PDF files.

• Quick Document Search: Simply enter the document name, and DocVault will quickly locate the relevant files, enabling you to access them without delay.

• Offline Access: Access your documents even without an internet connection. DocVault ensures that you can view and manage your documents anytime, anywhere.

• Seamless Sharing: Effortlessly share your documents via Email, WhatsApp, or any other preferred application.

• Robust Security Measures: Secure the app using a PIN, password, or biometric authentication options such as fingerprint or facial recognition.
